newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit extends gains on dollar/yen weakness.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit extends gains on dollar/yen weakness.

text.p: The ringgit extended gains in early Asian trading as the dollar continued its slide against the yen, dealers said.
"The dollar has fallen sharply against the yen but the ringgit has not gained as much. So there's room for ringgit to move higher," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
Dealers said the ringgit should test 2.5000 a dollar and possibly pressure the dollar/ringgit support level of 2.4950.
But lack of participation could restrict trading volume, they said.
At 0145 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5015/20 a dollar against 2.5066/69 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Friday.
